title: animated billboards
shortDescription: Four hundred animated sprites bouncing over a ground plane, drawn as billboards that face the camera
description: A `FeatureSprites` mesh of the `AnimatedSpriteKind` preset with room for 400 sprites, whose `FeatureSpritesMaterial` runs with `placement: BillboardPlacement` and with depth test and depth write switched on, so the sprites turn towards the orbiting camera and hide each other in the right order. Unlike in *animated sprites*, the animation is built in code rather than read from the texture catalog: `FrameBasedAnimations.add()` takes a name, a duration of 0.66 seconds, the `TileSet` and the tile ids of the frames. `bakeDataTexture()` turns the animations into the `animsMap` of the material, and the `time` uniform of the material drives them each frame. The ground is a plain three.js `PlaneGeometry` — the sprites share the scene with any other three.js object.
